name: Frontmatter Link Repair
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: To undo a repair, open the note's restore copy in Frontmatter Link Repair/Restore copies and copy its text back.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Frontmatter Link Repair is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your links working.
